_what_this_is: The Mavs pack's graph, in the shape of the mesh at pki.sgit.ai: the levels the game plays are derived from paths through it. GENERATED by packs/mavs/generate.py from the profiles.

ontology._what_this_is: The taxonomy the mesh is written in. Every node has one of these node types and every edge one of these edge types, with the direction stated; admin/build/gen_mesh.py refuses an edge whose type is not here or whose ends are not of the stated types. A coarse node is a named set of fine ones and is traversed identically (member-of), which is the fractal test: zooming never changes the format. Reach is a node, not a rung (brief v0.33.65).

vendor.label: vendor
vendor.means: who makes or provides the thing

profile.label: profile
profile.means: a named configuration of a product, listing its tools

tool.label: tool
tool.means: one tool inside a profile; the unit of mapping, because two tools in one session reach different things

family.label: family
family.means: the coarsest grouping of capabilities: filesystem, network, identity…

capability.label: capability
capability.means: verb × object class × reach class, with reversibility — the coarse node

exposure.label: exposure
exposure.means: a capability at one reach node — the fine node; the same verb and object at fs:user-home and at fs:container-layer are two exposures

reach.label: reach
reach.means: where a capability lands: a file system, a network, a credential store, a repository, a scheduler — a node with its own edges, not a rung

env.label: environment
env.means: where things run: a desktop, a container, a CI runner, a browser, the vendor's cloud

obligation.label: obligation
obligation.means: a control or article that governs a reach — reached by traversal, and never a compliance finding

evidence.label: evidence
evidence.means: a findings/v1 file: probe runs or an operator's account, dated, with a tier

question.label: question
question.means: one question the game asks, with its class, reliability and the capability it asks about

made-by.means: the profile is a configuration of this vendor's product

runs-in.means: runs in, or lives in, this environment

provided-by.means: the environment is provided by this vendor (or by you)

reaches.means: the tool can do this, here; attributes carry the control on the path, its tier, the evidence tier and a note

at.means: the exposure lands on this reach node

member-of.means: fine is a member of coarse; same shape either way

governed-by.means: an obligation that governs this reach — a question worth asking, at the weakest tier

evidenced-by.means: the tool's rows are established by this evidence file

asks-about.means: an eliciting question is a prediction about this capability

bounded-by.means: reserved: a control evidenced as the boundary on this exposure (not yet used)
